snapshot_timestamp_note: Date of retained database metadata bundle; timezone not inferred from folder naming.

record_counts.name: listing_records
record_counts.definition: Stored listing table rows; not a new holdout or a unique lifetime entity count.

record_counts.name: image_assets
record_counts.definition: Multiple images can belong to one listing.

record_counts.name: image_feature_records
record_counts.definition: Enrichment records, potentially versioned; not independent labeled outcomes.

record_counts.name: text_enrichment_records
record_counts.definition: Structured text-derived records; not raw token count.

record_counts.name: text_vector_records
record_counts.definition: 768-dimensional vector records; versions and source coverage differ from listing rows.

record_counts.name: image_vector_records
record_counts.definition: 512-dimensional vector records; not all stored images necessarily embedded.

record_counts.name: post_event_audit_records
record_counts.definition: Outcome-stage audit records, excluded from decision-time inputs unless a distinct admissible contract applies.

scheduler_interpretation: Retained history of one scheduler metadata database; run state is final stored state, not first-attempt success or uptime. Retained execution dates end earlier than backup date. Task instances are not added to workflow runs.

lifetime_volume.scope: Larger lifetime platform history, outside the one retained scheduler snapshot.

provenance.basis: Read-only retrospective inspection of retained metadata, scheduler records, and restoration reports. Raw private artifacts are not redistributed.
provenance.hash_scope: Hashes identify earlier audit summary receipts, not a full raw database digest; receipt contents are not distributed.

retained_survival_inference_workflow.scope: One inference workflow within the retained scheduler snapshot; not all model-stage jobs.
